failure_modes: Automating orchestration on too little data
gloss: Automate agent orchestration with a probabilistic transition model, guarded by strong routing
invariants: Expert knowledge constrains the learned model
Routing is decided by the strongest model
mechanism: The human's job as orchestrator is the frontier bottleneck. To automate it, build an {{graph}} from harness metadata and use it to plan toward target states. Routing decisions stay with a strong model per {{router}}, and cheap workers follow {{tradeoff}}. Expert heuristics act as guardrails on the black-box system.
